checks.text: The page shows the heading "Box Shadow Generator".
With the default settings (X: 0, Y: 4, Blur: 12, Spread: 0, Color: #000000, Opacity: 100), the code area displays exactly `box-shadow: 0px 4px 12px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);`.
Typing `10` in the field labelled "X offset" and `20` in the field labelled "Y offset" updates the code area to display `box-shadow: 10px 20px 12px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);`.
Typing `5` in the field labelled "Blur" and `3` in the field labelled "Spread" updates the code area to display `box-shadow: 10px 20px 5px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);`.
Clicking the button labelled "Copy CSS" displays a toast with the text "CSS copied to clipboard".
Typing `50` in the field labelled "Opacity" updates the code area to display `box-shadow: 10px 20px 5px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);`.
Typing `ff0000` in the hex input of the color picker updates the code area to display `box-shadow: 10px 20px 5px 3px rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.5);`.
Clicking the button labelled "Reset" restores the code area to `box-shadow: 0px 4px 12px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);`.

Reload keeps the last saved shadow settings: after setting X to `10` and reloading, the field labelled "X offset" contains `10` and the code area displays `box-shadow: 10px 4px 12px 0px rgba(0, 0, 0, 1);`.
